description: A Company with no OAuth issuer (spec 3.2): signed-out Sessions, its identifier its HTTPS domain, and no sign-in. The company cases run against the reference company configured as the world says, in every language pairing. An error is never read as no issuer: the no-fallback cases change one discovery answer and the discovery stops.

cases.description: The domain's protected resource metadata is a 404: the Company has no issuer and no OAuth metadata, and its identifier is https://{organization.domain}.
Valid protected resource metadata with authorization_servers absent or empty says the same as a 404.
A signed-out Company runs no authorization server: its OAuth endpoints and metadata are not there, and poppy.json has no auth.issuer.
A Session JWT names the identifier in aud, which the Company accepts; any other aud is invalid_session.
Conversations, feedback and browser join work signed out, with verified Sessions and no authorization server.
Sign-in at a Company with no issuer is refused by the SDK, with no request sent.
A 500 from the domain's protected resource metadata stops discovery: never the domain.
A timeout at the domain's protected resource metadata stops discovery: never the domain.
Invalid protected resource metadata stops discovery: never the domain.
An issuer that can't be verified stops discovery: its metadata is not published, and the domain is not used instead.
A document that offers sign-in, by auth.issuer, an access signed_in entry or Mediated Sign-In, can't be served by a domain with no issuer.
